description:
Fantastic location by Roundhay Park. Close to local amenities. Close to major bus and transport links. Private garden with gardener included. house alarm. two allocated parking spaces.

Linley and Simpson are delighted to present this beautiful stone built two bedroom cottage. The property benefits from its many original features as well as having a private garden, secure store room and two allocated parking spaces. Located just on the edge of Roundhay Park just a few minutes walk to Canal Gardens, Tropical World and the many amenities on Street Lane. This unique property is available UNFURNISHED and briefly comprises; Open plan living room/kitchen with fireplace, master bedroom with built in wardrobes, second bedroom, and contemporary house bathroom with shower over bath.  
Gas central heating and double glazing throughout.  Large storage undercroft - acces from outside.
